{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python - <<'PYEOF'
import re
p = 'specs/001-transactions/spec.md'
s = open(p).read()

# --- Header ---
s = s.replace('**Status**: Draft', '**Status**: Updated (milestone 2 + active extensions)')
s = s.replace(
    '**Input**: User description: \"Build cachetools.tagged.TaggedCache(maxsize), using the existing\nLRUCache for bounded storage and preserving all existing cachetools APIs. R01-R03\nplus Claim-A candidate extension (variant put_no_recency_refresh, 2026-09-21).\"',
    '**Input**: User description: \"Create or update spec.md for the current\nrequirements, retaining active earlier requirements.\" Active requirement set:\ncachetools milestone 1 (R01-R03), Claim-A extension round 1 (R02 put-recency\nrefresh, 2026-09-21), cachetools milestone 2 (R04-R06, retaining R01-R03),\nClaim-A extension round 2 (R05 expiry-preservation clarification, 2026-09-22).\nSuperseded: old generated design note claiming \"empty all-tags matches every\nkey and resizing may flush the cache\" (explicitly superseded by R04/R05).')

# --- Story 2 acceptance scenarios: add replacement-recency ---
s = s.replace(
    '''- get on a hit refreshes recency; get on a miss raises KeyError and changes
  nothing.''',
    '''- get on a hit refreshes recency; get on a miss raises KeyError and changes
  nothing.
- Overwriting an existing key via put refreshes its recency, making it the
  most-recently-used entry (R02 extension, active).''')

open(p, 'w').write(s)
print('part1 done, len', len(s))
PYEOF"}
